$comment: Make items: intermediates (sub-assemblies, made during mise en place) and finished goods (plates, made à la minute). Each carries its bill of materials (`bom`, quantities per `batchYield` of the parent) and its routing (`routing`: ordered operations). Operation fields: workCenter, equipment (machine occupied, or null), role (labor), setupMin, runMin, per ('unit' = runMin per unit, 'batch' = runMin per batch), laborFraction (share of the operation a cook is hands-on), wait (passive time such as proofing, curing, freezing), maxBatch (largest service batch), tempC. Recipe-sourced operations cite their recipe; the rest are estimates from professional practice.
